description: Calculate weighted priorities for all tickets, sorted descending. Inline w1-w4 override stored weights for this call only. Returns {title, priority, weighted} per ticket. For de-risk-first ordering, use ticket_list with sort='risk' instead.

limit.description: Max number of entries to return (default: all)

offset.description: Number of entries to skip, to page through a list too large for one result

tags.description: Only tickets with all of these tags (intersection, also with tag). Each as prefix:value

w1.description: Benefit weight (default 1.5). Higher = benefit matters more in value.

w2.description: Penalty weight (default 1.5). Higher = penalty matters more in value.

w3.description: Estimate weight (default 1.5). Higher = large estimates are penalised more.

w4.description: Risk weight (default 1.5). Higher = risky items are penalised more. To de-risk first, sort by risk via ticket_list instead.

name: calc_priority

weighted.description: value / cost with the weights applied
